description: Server-side JavaScript code for a database visualization and management API using Express.js, supporting multiple database types (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB). It loads environment variables, configures database adapters, tests connections, and exposes REST API endpoints for database info, tables, and data retrieval.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Base class for database adapters, defining interface methods for testing connection, retrieving tables, and data.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter, providing common SQL query execution methods.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL, implementing execute, getTableQuery, getDataQuery.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MySQL, implementing execute, getTableQuery, getDataQuery.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SQLite, implementing execute, getTableQuery, getDataQuery, and testConnection.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB, implementing getTables, getData, and connection handling.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from .env files for different databases.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connectivity for configured databases and reports success or failure.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests, executing operations on specified database adapters.
